name: data-reasoning
description: Skills for reasoning from data — structured exploration that generates honest leads, hypothesis-driven investigation that adjudicates them, and causal identification review that turns a dead end into a reviewed, assumption-bounded design.

interface.shortDescription: Explore data and test hypotheses with disciplined workflows
interface.longDescription: Use structured workflows for exploratory data analysis, hypothesis-driven investigation, and causal identification review, with explicit evidence, predictions, stopping rules, and assumption-bounded designs when nothing else identifies the effect.
defaultPrompt: Explore this dataset and identify the strongest leads.
Turn this question into a hypothesis-driven analysis plan.
Evaluate whether the evidence supports these competing hypotheses.
Review whether this design identifies the effect, and on what assumptions.
